intent: Write an accurate planned-exercise explanation with singular notice agreement, two valid before constructions and current-plan information boundaries.
picturePurpose: Precise coded sentence repair, paired before constructions and current-information choices support writing without depicting a fictional disaster as evidence.

workshop.title: 把演练说明写准确：is、before、当前安排
workshop.instruction: 先修主谓，再比较两种before结构，最后检查信息和书面形式。自己写2—4句，不能把演练改成警报，也不编集合安排。

items.label: This notice is：主谓和通知性质一起检查
items.prompt: 补全这一个通知的说明，再核对planned的含义。
items.hint: This notice是单数，当前说明用is。planned safety exercise指计划中的演练，不能改成正在发生真实灾情。
items.reason: 主谓与通知性质已核对。成稿可以换自然写法，但要说明演练不是实时警报。
items.material: 写2—4句英文。向同学说明一份演练通知是计划中的练习，不是实时灾情警报。提醒先听老师说明集合信号。 人名可用虚构名字，不写真实住址或联系方式。

composeBrief.title: 单数notice → is → planned exercise
composeBrief.hint: This notice是单数，当前说明用is。planned safety exercise指计划中的演练，不能改成正在发生真实灾情。
composeBrief.wrong: This notice是单数，本句用is，不用are或be。planned exercise是计划演练；语法修对也不能把它改成实时灾情或取消通知。

fields.label: This notice ___ about a planned safety exercise.

choices.label: A planned exercise, not a live warning.
A live warning that a real emergency is happening now.
Proof that the school has cancelled the exercise.

items.label: before + 从句，或before + -ing
items.prompt: 选一种开始前的表达，再配完整句。
items.hint: before the session begins用主语session加begins；before beginning the session用-ing。两种都能表达先听说明，再开始。
items.reason: 所选before结构与句子已对应。其他准确写法也可以，但不能把开始前改成开始后。
items.material: 写2—4句英文。向同学说明一份演练通知是计划中的练习，不是实时灾情警报。提醒先听老师说明集合信号。 人名可用虚构名字，不写真实住址或联系方式。

composeBrief.title: before the session begins ↔ before beginning the session
composeBrief.hint: before the session begins用主语session加begins；before beginning the session用-ing。两种都能表达先听说明，再开始。
composeBrief.wrong: 两种正确句都可用，本卡要与所选结构对应。before the session begins中单数session后用begins；before beginning the session中用-ing。不能漏写begins的-s。

choices.label: We should listen to the teacher before the session begins.
We should listen to the teacher before beginning the session.
We should listen to the teacher before the session begin.

items.label: 写清要确认什么，不替老师编安排
items.prompt: 核对当前安排、未知细节与最终书面形式。
items.hint: 写明先听老师说明当前计划和约定信号。题目没给具体集合点或信号，不可编成已经确认的事实。实际交2—4个英文句子。
items.reason: 当前安排与书面形式已核对。回到自己的稿子检查通知性质、开始前的动作和信息边界。
items.material: 写2—4句英文。向同学说明一份演练通知是计划中的练习，不是实时灾情警报。提醒先听老师说明集合信号。 人名可用虚构名字，不写真实住址或联系方式。

composeBrief.title: 当前说明 → 不编细节 → 书面句子
composeBrief.hint: 写明先听老师说明当前计划和约定信号。题目没给具体集合点或信号，不可编成已经确认的事实。实际交2—4个英文句子。
composeBrief.wrong: 题目要求先听当前学校安排，不是凭无日期截图或猜测决定。未提供的集合点和信号应求证，不编成既定事实；关键词或只录音都不能代替书面句子。

choices.label: The teacher’s explanation of the current school plan and agreed signal.
Any undated screenshot that looks official.
An invented plan said to apply to every school.
Two to four complete written English sentences.
Only a recording, without a written response.
Only the words planned, teacher and signal.

transfer.stem: 换成图书馆参观前的演练，哪份英文稿既符合通知，又正确使用了notice和before？
transfer.passage:
换一份通知，自己写清要求
这份通知安排的是图书馆参观前的计划演练，并非实时警报。演练开始前，须听图书管理员（librarian）说明当前安排和约定信号。题目没有提供具体集合地点、时间或信号。请用2—4句英文说明通知内容和应先做的事。

options.text: This notice are about a planned practice before a library visit, not a live warning. We should listen to the librarian explain the current arrangements before the practice begins. We should check the agreed signal instead of inventing one.
This notice is about a planned practice before a library visit, not a live warning. We should start the practice before listening to the current arrangements. We can invent the signal afterwards.

This notice is about a planned practice before a library visit, not a live warning. We should listen to the librarian explain the current arrangements before beginning the practice. We should check the agreed signal instead of inventing one.

This notice is about a planned safety exercise at school, not a live warning. We should listen to the teacher explain the school plan before the session begins. We should check the school’s agreed signal.

answer.display: This notice is about a planned practice before a library visit, not a live warning. We should listen to the librarian explain the current arrangements before beginning the practice. We should check the agreed signal instead of inventing one.

explanation.strategy: 先更新图书馆情境与负责人，再检查单数主语和开始前的结构。

steps.text: 新通知是图书馆参观前的练习，由图书管理员说明当前安排。
steps.reason: 学校老师的旧题表达不能直接代替新任务。

steps.text: This notice is保持单数；before beginning the practice表示先听说明再开始。
steps.reason: 也可以写before the practice begins；两种结构都准确，不必只认一种。

distractors.reason: 新情境和先听说明的顺序正确，但单数This notice不能配are，应改成is。
主谓正确，却把先听当前安排改成先开始，还自行编信号，没有完成原定顺序与求证要求。
句子本身通顺，却仍在介绍学校老师的旧情境，未更新图书馆参观与图书管理员。

explanation.pitfall: 只修语法却没有回应新情境，或把同样正确的before从句与-ing表达误判为只能选一种。

visual.title: 更新情境，再检查主谓与时点

segments.text: before beginning / before the practice begins
segments.note: 两种准确的开始前表达

visual.caption: 写清当前安排需要求证，不补造集合点或信号。

explanation.transfer: 若改成These notices，谓语怎样调整？改动主语后，开始前确认安排这一要求会改变吗？
